method: Read the current source-based ability summaries and captured official hero mechanics. Author narrow situational coaching; values are subjective qualitative assessments, not verified win probabilities. No gameplay testing or telemetry was used. Official page hashes are retained in ability-evidence.json.
limitations: Only 55 directed hero matchups are assessed; all other pairs remain unknown.
Advice does not model every perk, map, teammate or player skill difference.
Newer hero assessments mostly remain neutral because their full matchup behavior is not established.

matchups.explanation: Healing denial can pressure Take a Breather if the grenade lands. First account for Trash Compactor collecting incoming projectiles; use an unobstructed angle after that resource is spent. Stay outside a comfortable hook angle and call for follow-up rather than treating anti-heal as a solo kill.

Approaching on a straight Inferno Rush gives Cassidy a predictable ranged target. Use cover to shorten the approach, keep Dancing Blaze available for the exposed part, and disengage if the opening disappears. This is an approach-risk assessment, not a claim that either hero wins every duel.

Scoped Viper shots give your team a direct way to contest an exposed flying target. Hold a covered sightline and lead the team call on the airborne threat instead of chasing underneath her. Pharah can still attack another angle or break the sightline; aim and teammate support remain decisive.

A destroyable Immortality Field can protect the follow-up area when an ally is pulled, but its placement and line of sight matter. Put it behind cover where the pulled ally can benefit, and coordinate escape and healing. Do not assume the lamp makes a hook harmless or cannot be destroyed.

Assault configuration provides sustained fire to pressure a barrier position. Keep an escape corner and shoot when your team can also advance; remaining exposed while transformed invites Charge or a flank. Barrier pressure is the useful interaction here, not an automatic team-fight win.

Whip Shot can separate a nearby flanker from the teammate you are protecting, while landed damage starts Inspire. Stay near cover and your other support, watch Tracer movement, and avoid pursuing her Blink route alone. This entry favors a peel plan and leaves the overall duel unrated.

Aimed Peacekeeper shots can contest Pharah when she exposes a clear line of sight. Use cover and a range where your shots are useful rather than walking into her rockets to force the duel. Aim, range and whether she has another angle determine how much pressure you can apply.

Plasma Saber needs proximity, while a scoped Widowmaker can pressure the crossing before you reach her. Route through cover, use the frontal barrier on the dangerous sightline and preserve Propulsors to finish or abandon the approach. Horizontal movement alone is not reliable access to every sniper ledge.

Boosters let you reach an airborne angle and Matrix can intercept eligible rockets in front of the mech. Contest the flight path with team support, then return before the backline is abandoned. Matrix coverage and mobility resources are limited; this is threat coverage, not guaranteed elimination.

Shrouded Momentum gives a movement and damage-reduction option against a close flank. Keep a teammate and a retreat corner nearby, move before the pressure surrounds you, and use Invigorating Drones to support the ally taking the duel. The current sources do not establish a general counter advantage.

Sonic Repulsors can create space from a close shotgun approach, with an additional stun when the pushed target meets a wall. Save the displacement for the committed approach rather than spending it on distant poke. Reaper can reposition or leave with Wraith Form; do not assume every push traps him.

Ana has a disabling projectile that can interrupt an exposed engagement. Track the dart, use cover on the approach, and keep Slam or another exit available instead of blocking motionless in an open lane. This advice does not treat Power Block as full immunity to crowd control.

Flight lets you threaten an angle around a forward-facing barrier. Work from a covered elevated or side angle and avoid descending into hammer range without an exit. Reinhardt can turn the barrier and teammates can contest you; the advantage is angle access, not guaranteed barrier bypass for every attack.

Aimed burst fire lets you apply pressure before Reaper reaches close shotgun range. Hold a retreat route, reposition when he closes the gap, and use Cyber Frag to pressure the route rather than waiting for Altered Vitals to rescue an exposed duel. Overall matchup strength remains untested.

Updraft and Quick Dash can help find a firing angle beside a barrier, but a frontal barrier still denies a clean shot. Use the movement to change sightlines and keep an exit instead of committing to a narrow stationary angle. This is positioning advice rather than a reviewed claim of a favorable duel.

Tesla Cannon pressure is not an incoming projectile to return with Deflect. Avoid staying in close electrical pressure, save Swift Strike to leave, and look for a separate target after Winston commits elsewhere. A coordinated team can still punish his approach; do not interpret this as a solo duel rule without context.

Sonic Arrow can reveal the area around an impact and help your team check a sniper angle. Use the information from cover, vary the next peek, and do not hold the same exposed line while charging a shot. Information helps planning but does not guarantee that an arrow duel is favorable.

Violent Leap and ledge access can shorten a route toward a sniper, while Jagged Wall can change the immediate fight space. Approach from cover with a supported exit and check whether the ledge is actually reachable. Movement access alone does not establish a favorable engagement against every sniper position.

Tracer can change angles quickly and attack an exposed deployable. Put Healing Pylon behind a protected angle, use Outburst to create space when she reaches you, and fight alongside a teammate instead of following her route. This is a pylon-protection plan, not an asserted hard counter.

Uncovered flight makes you a visible target for aimed revolver fire, especially while carrying an ally. Use walls and short crossings, avoid hovering in a predictable lane, and drop into cover before committing fuel to another route. Actual pressure depends on distance and aim.

Your wound-based healing plan is vulnerable when healing denial lands. Track the grenade, stage beside cover and preserve Commanding Shout for a needed exit rather than expecting self-healing to sustain the push. Teammate cleansing and whether the grenade connects can change the engagement.

Bouncing ground-oriented explosives are harder to connect with a moving airborne target than with a nearby ground route. Use cover from rocket sightlines, pressure the ground team and ask a ranged teammate to contest flight. Do not climb into an exposed position solely to force difficult airborne shots.

Glide Boost and Hyper Ring help you relocate after Winston chooses a landing position. Keep an exit route and move with your teammate rather than remaining inside the new close-range pressure. Horizontal movement does not guarantee an escape from every jump or enclosed route.

Protection Suzu can answer healing denial or sleep on a teammate, making it a useful response to Ana utility. Wait for the harmful effect and coordinate the recovery rather than spending it on minor poke. Resource timing, aim and the other enemy threats can still leave your team exposed.

Life Grip gives you a way to bring a threatened teammate toward your protected position. Prepare a safe destination and react to the pull or follow-up with team coordination; do not stand on the same hook lane yourself. Availability and timing matter, and this is not a guarantee against every hook sequence.

Soundwave can separate a close shotgun threat from a teammate. Hold a corner, keep the group moving and push the committed approach rather than chasing the escape. Reaper can reposition, so a useful peel interaction does not establish a favorable solo duel.

Cardiac Overdrive relies partly on healing through damage, so landed healing denial disrupts that sustain plan. Stage behind cover, track the grenade and avoid using the sustain resource as permission to stay exposed while anti-healed. Teammate cleansing and the approach angle can change the outcome.

Ice Wall can divide a committed frontline from its support or close a route after Charge passes. Look for an actual separation with your team ready to follow, then remove an unhelpful wall promptly. A wall that also blocks your own follow-up is not an advantage.

An exposed resurrection position is a predictable sniper sightline. Check the angle first, use cover and decline the resurrection if the route cannot be protected. Guardian Angel is an escape tool, not proof that you can safely remain in a visible scoped lane.

Binding Chain offers movement restriction if it connects with a close flanker. Save it for a committed angle and coordinate follow-up while retaining a safe Katashiro Return destination. Tracer movement and Recall still make the exchange conditional; no general counter advantage is established.

Fade can break an exposed close-range exchange and let you rejoin a teammate. Keep it available for danger, use nearby cover and heal the ally taking the duel instead of chasing Tracer after she relocates. Survival utility does not turn the matchup into a guaranteed win.

Energy Javelin gives a stun and displacement response to a visible committed approach. Keep a sightline for the projectile and save it for a meaningful engagement rather than distant poke. Doomfist can change the route or leave before the shot connects; this is a conditional control advantage.

Flight lets you pressure from outside the hammer’s direct reach and change angles around a forward barrier. Preserve cover from the ranged members of his team and avoid landing in the close fight with fuel exhausted. The assessment concerns Reinhardt’s reach, not the full opposing composition.

Nemesis pressure needs a reachable close angle, while Widowmaker can threaten the crossing from a distant ledge. Use the Omnic barrier and covered rotations to support the approach rather than spending the close-range form far away. Whether the team can access the sniper position is decisive.

Your close-range shotguns can pressure Winston when he commits near your team. Protect the landing area, keep a Wraith exit and avoid pursuing him into an unsupported jump route. Team focus and barriers affect the exchange; this is a close-range pressure recommendation rather than a measured duel result.

A flying target is difficult to reach with the hammer. Use the barrier and solid cover to move the team safely, pressure a reachable ground target and ask ranged teammates to cover flight. Do not abandon the frontline to chase an airborne enemy you cannot reliably reach.

Healing denial can disrupt Breather after the grenade lands. Use cover or Trash Compactor against eligible incoming projectiles and keep the hook threat from a protected angle. Do not rely on Breather while healing is denied; timing and teammate cleansing can change the fight.

Mei can slow a nearby approach and use Ice Wall to change the escape route. Keep Evade for a real exit and approach from an angle with space instead of committing the bike into a narrow team fight. The current source descriptions support this positioning caution, not a reviewed general duel ranking.

Set Anchor Drone at a safe retreat point before Reaper reaches shotgun distance. Apply rifle pressure on the approach, then move when he commits rather than waiting inside close range. An unsafe anchor can simply move you into another threat; this is a spacing plan with no play-tested matchup rank.

Kinetic Grasp can intercept frontal projectiles and convert pressure into extra health during the exposed firing phase. Combine it with cover and the movable barrier, then withdraw when resources run low. Side angles and forced control can defeat this plan; it is not permanent immunity to Assault fire.

Charged railgun shots give your team a ranged threat against an exposed flyer. Build energy safely, use a covered angle for the shot and preserve Power Slide rather than chasing under the rockets. Aim, available energy and other enemy angles determine the real value.

Automatic rifle fire provides sustained pressure on an airborne target in a clear sightline. Work from cover, reposition with Sprint and focus the call with teammates instead of standing still in the rocket lane. Range, aim and support decide whether you can maintain the pressure.

Conspirator tells you which opposing ultimates are charged, so a ready Transcendence can inform the team’s engagement call. Share the information and support your ally with Hotfix rather than assuming the old damage-role flank plan applies to this support rework. This entry is information-based coaching with an unrated duel.

The beam is distinct from the projectiles Matrix intercepts, so close beam pressure can challenge a Matrix stance. Keep cover and watch the mech’s mobility; do not walk through other enemy fire just to maintain beam contact. This narrow interaction does not mean the mech cannot disengage or pressure you from another angle.

A protected turret can add pressure to a flank route while you cover a teammate. Place it where the team can defend it and move with Overload when the close fight turns dangerous. Tracer can break sightlines or focus the deployable, so turret presence is not a guaranteed counter.

Blink lets you threaten a new close angle against a hero whose listed kit has no movement escape. Stage with cover, track Discord and leave before the team turns toward you; Snap Kick can disrupt a careless close approach. This is an angle-access recommendation, not a guaranteed solo elimination.

The sword needs a close reachable target, while Pharah can fight from flight. Use cover and a reachable ground target, preserving Soaring Slice for a useful route rather than an unsupported airborne chase. The opposing team’s ranged threats matter more than trying to force this reach mismatch.

The excavator’s limited projectile travel and ground-based pressure make distant flight difficult to contest. Use Burrow to rotate toward a grounded target and coordinate with a ranged ally for air coverage. Leaving a protected route to chase flight wastes the advantage of your ground access.

Jump Pack lets Winston contest a sniper ledge, with the dome changing the immediate sightline. Keep Grappling Hook and a second position ready, relocate before the close fight settles and call for support. A distant or inaccessible landing angle can still favor your sightline.

Jump Pack and a barrier let you contest a reachable sniper position. Check the route and teammate follow-up before jumping, then keep an exit when she grapples away. Do not treat vertical access as permission to dive through the entire team alone.

Swing access and displacement let you pressure a reachable backline position. Enter from cover, respect Discord and leave before the team focuses the ball; Snap Kick and nearby peel can interrupt an overlong stay. This is a disruption opportunity rather than a predicted duel win.

Guardian Wave can push a close approach away while improving healing received by your allies. Keep an escape route with Rushing Torrent and protect the teammate being approached rather than chasing Reaper. His Wraith reposition and your resource timing keep the exchange conditional.

Particle beam pressure is not a projectile for Matrix to intercept. Work inside a supported beam angle and preserve barriers for actual incoming pressure instead of chasing the mech across exposed ground. Boosters can move her out of the effective fight; no general win probability is implied.

A flanker can change close angles faster than you can walk away. Keep a peel teammate and solid cover nearby, use Snap Kick for space and call the flank early. Discord creates follow-up pressure, but it does not itself provide a movement escape.

Matrix intercepts projectiles rather than the particle beam. Avoid a prolonged close beam duel, use Boosters to contest a different angle and protect a teammate threatened by eligible projectiles. Your mobility and the wider composition can still make the selection useful.
